name.value: Abercorn Hotel, Trademark Collection by Wyndham

description.value: The Abercorn Hotel is a full-service hotel in Richmond, BC, operating under Wyndham's Trademark Collection brand, which groups independently spirited hotels with distinct local character. Located on Bridgeport Road near Richmond's commercial core and close to YVR airport, it is a practical base for cyclists exploring the Fraser delta and the regional trail network. As a Wyndham property it participates in the Wyndham Rewards loyalty program.
